# Emre Gover

## Key page

- Title: What Do Women Really Want? The Lancelot Answer
- URL: https://emregover.github.io/what-do-women-really-want/
- Author: Emre Gover (@emregover)
- Source thread: https://x.com/emregover/status/2063713900030316616
- Summary: Emre Gover's answer to "What do women really want?" is sovereignty over their own lives. No buts. The idea is framed through the Lancelot and witch story.
- Key quote: Women want sovereignty over their own lives. Not conditional permission. Not control with better branding. No but.
